office: the residents' office of the municipality in most cantons
note: Read from the municipality of Vaz/Obervaz (Graubünden), whose residents' office takes the card at the federal fee: CHF 70 from 18, valid ten years, CHF 35 under 18, valid five. The delivery time it gives (10 to 15 working days) is the passport's. Applying abroad isn't modelled: the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs' pages answer 403; the federal ordinance (VAwG, SR 143.11) wasn't reached either (Fedlex returns its 404 page).

sources.title: Gemeinde Vaz/Obervaz, Infoblatt Schweizer Identitätskarte und Schweizer Pass
sources.said: Eine Identitätskarte kann nach wie vor am Schalter der Einwohnerkontrolle in Lenzerheide beantragt werden. ... Erwachsene ab 18 Jahren 10 Jahre CHF 70.– Kinder bis 18. Altersjahr 5 Jahre CHF 35.–
